lines.en: I inch my way across the ground
I am barely more than half a block

lines.zh: 我短短的腿一下一下蹬
lines.en: My stubby legs kick one at a time
I drag my body forward

lines.zh: 我从一片叶下爬到另一片
lines.en: I crawl from one leaf to another

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃地挪了两步
lines.en: I wobble two steps forward

lines.zh: 我的身体一伸一缩地往前
lines.en: My body stretches and contracts forward

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在后面拖着走
lines.en: My tail drags behind me

lines.zh: 我顺着一条泥痕往前爬
lines.en: I crawl along a trail in the mud
I move slowly under a blade of grass

lines.zh: 我抬起头看路，再低下头爬
lines.en: I raise my head to see the way, then lower it to crawl
I lie on the ground without moving
I spread myself into a small patch
My eyes roll very slowly
I wait for the sun to rise
I press against a warm stone

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块小石头
lines.en: I stay still like a little stone

lines.zh: 我听见草叶被压的声音
lines.en: I hear blades being pressed
I slowly curl myself up

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把地上的灰吹开
lines.en: My breath blows the dust off the ground
I am warming my back
I rest my head on the soil
My body pulses in and out

lines.zh: 我听见水在很远的地方
lines.en: I hear water far away
I stay curled without moving
How big you are
I only reach your instep
Are you going to tread on me
I tilt my head up at you

lines.zh: 我仰着头，眼睛还没看清你。
lines.en: I tilt my head up, my eyes not yet taking all of you in.
My life is thin as a membrane
It would be better if you crouched
I am here, do not step on me
I cannot see all of you
Your voice is very loud
I fear being trodden on
Your footsteps keep shaking the ground
I hardly dare to move

lines.zh: 你会不会带我去有太阳的地方
lines.en: Will you take me somewhere sunny

lines.zh: 我只想安安静静地长大
lines.en: I only want to grow up quietly
I can recognize your shoes
I have been pressed flatter
I cannot move at all
I struggle once
Being this small, I cannot take it
The blow flipped me over
I lie on my back
I slowly roll onto my front
I have only a tiny amount of life
It hurts too much to move

lines.zh: 你手上是给幼年期的吗
lines.en: Is that In-Training feed in your hand
I caught a little of the smell

lines.zh: 那点饲料的味道，我够不到。
lines.en: That pellet's smell is just out of my reach.
I crawl slowly, you must wait
I can hold this in my mouth
Only on the ground will I dare come

lines.zh: 这个味道我记了第一次
lines.en: I noted this smell for the first time
Could you come a little closer

lines.zh: 我挪一步停一下，怕你走开。
lines.en: I shuffle one step, pause, afraid you will walk away.
My teeth cannot wear through it
Wait for me a moment
I rolled half a block
It does not hurt, I am just dazed
Leave a little space for me
I press back to the ground
You squeezed me out of place
I slid a stretch along the ground
I turn over slowly
I press back down and keep crawling
I have not grown enough
I shake my head, I do not follow
I go on lying here
I am small, I only want to eat
I have no idea about any of it
I curl myself up
I shift away from you
I bury my face in the soil

lines.zh: 我摆了摆尾巴，没有别的意思
lines.en: I wag my tail, nothing more
It is stuck at my throat
I pin it with my body
I tried for a long time
I leave it and turn away
I wrap my body around it
I can wear this down slowly
I tried twice and failed

lines.zh: 地上爬的也想被抱一抱。
lines.en: Even a crawler wants to be held.
The soil over there is turning
I cannot move very fast
I am getting ready to crawl over

lines.zh: 土粒一动，我就转头过去。
lines.en: A grain of soil shifts, and I turn toward it.
I raise my head out of the soil

lines.zh: 我的身体动得比刚才快
lines.en: My body moves faster than before
There is a smell in that direction
I watch while I crawl
I start shifting that way

lines.zh: 我把身体压低贴着地面
lines.en: I flatten my body to the ground
I start squeezing forward
I crawl over bit by bit
It is still several blocks away
I am getting tired of crawling
I rest a moment and go on

lines.zh: 我贴着草根，一点一点靠近。
lines.en: I hug the grass roots and inch closer.
I crawl slowly and never stop
Two more blocks and I am there
I stop by its feet
I wait for it to lower its head
Its shadow covers half of me
I am somewhere it cannot see
One push moves it barely
I bite once and back off
I bump its foot

lines.zh: 我用整个身子撞它的脚趾。
lines.en: I throw my whole body against its toe.

lines.zh: 我的力气只够推它一下
lines.en: My strength is only enough to push it once

lines.zh: 我吐出一个泡泡，啪地破了。
lines.en: I spit out a bubble, and it pops with a snap.
I curl up and wait for it to go
I was bounced away
I keep pushing forward
I butt it with my brow
I was hatched from a Digitama
I am not even the size of your shoe

lines.zh: 森林和平原都是我的家
lines.en: Forest and plains are both my home

lines.zh: 我一次和很多同伴一起出现
lines.en: I appear with many companions at once
I am about to start eating
I slowly crawl into the sun

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，我落在草地上。
lines.en: The eggshell cracks and I drop onto the grass.
I try to stand and cannot
Everything around me is so tall
First I look for a warm spot
My tail has not grown long yet

lines.zh: 我在草甸的边上停下来
lines.en: I stop at the edge of the meadow

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我整个都热了
lines.en: The fire came near and all of me went hot
I rolled down from a low place
The water covered me at once
The blast blew me away

lines.zh: 有个小东西打在我身上
lines.en: Something small struck me

lines.zh: 那股术力让我抽了一下
lines.en: That magic made me twitch
I am hungry, and I am still small
The flash turned the ground white

lines.zh: 虚空中我小得像一粒沙。
lines.en: In the void I am as small as a grain of sand.
